headline: Platinum's Back
caption:
Mike Perry is back in the UFC, and Jorge Masvidal is reportedly the target.
Perry or Masvidal? 👇

His manager Malki Kawa says Perry re-signed more than five years after leaving the UFC, following his 6-0 BKFC run. No opponent or date is official yet.

🔥 Hot take: Perry vs Masvidal sells more than half the title fights this year.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Perry or Masvidal?
hot_take: Perry vs Masvidal *sells* more than most title fights.
